name: Seawater sulfate removal for injection water
aliases: Seawater sulfate removal for injection water
principle: Nanofiltration membranes strip sulfate from seawater before injection so it does not form barium sulfate scale with reservoir water. At Marathon's Brae field the first plant (South Brae, 1988) handled 40,000 bw/d with sulfate rejection of 98 to 99% and about 75% feed recovery.

source.note: Oil & Gas Journal, Membranes solve North Sea waterflood sulfate problems
